caption_used: Negative log-probabilities for clinically relevant tokens between baseline MistralV0.2-Base and the same model further fine-tuned on each specialty data. The chart displays six specialty groups along the x-axis (Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, Pediatrics), with the y-axis showing negative log probability ranging from approximately -27 to -22. Within each group, the MistralV0.2-Base bar (light blue) consistently shows the highest negative log probability, indicating weaker token predictions at baseline. Among the fine-tuned models, the Gastro-tuned variant achieves the lowest negative log probability across most specialty groups, suggesting strong cross-specialty transfer. Notably, the Infect group shows the largest overall bar heights, with baseline reaching approximately -23.5, while the Cardio group exhibits the smallest spread between baseline and fine-tuned variants at roughly 1.5 units.
raw_response: This figure presents a bar chart illustrating the negative log probability of clinically relevant terms for a MistralV0.2-Base model compared to models fine-tuned on various clinical specialties. The horizontal axis represents the clinical specialties – Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics – listed in alphabetical order. The vertical axis, labeled “Negative log probability,” ranges from approximately -27 to -22 and utilizes a linear scale with tick intervals of approximately 1.5 units. The bars represent the negative log probability values for each specialty group. The MistralV0.2-Base model is depicted as a light blue bar, consistently positioned at the highest point on the y-axis for each specialty, indicating a lower negative log probability (stronger token predictions) compared to the fine-tuned models. The fine-tuned models are represented by six differently colored bars: Gastro (orange), Cardio (dark orange), Infect (red), Neuro (brown), Obstetrics (yellow), and Pediatrics (gray). The Gastro-tuned model consistently exhibits the lowest negative log probability across most specialty groups, with a value of approximately -26.2. The Infect group displays the tallest bar, reaching a negative log probability of approximately -23.5, while the Cardio group shows the smallest variation between the baseline and fine-tuned models, with a difference of approximately 1.5 units. All bars are presented in a sorted order based on the x-axis labels.
